metadata.description: Multi-model orchestration for Claude Code: Claude plans and reviews while workers run on Claude (Fable, Opus, Sonnet) or Gemini, routed by task and remaining quota. Claude workers are Diablo 2 heroes, and Gemini workers are ravers, a water crew and scientists.

plugins.name: savvy-flow
plugins.description: Skill: multi-model orchestration. Plan, delegate to tiered Claude workers (Sonnet for fully specified tasks, Opus medium for judgment, Sonnet tester), side sessions in the desktop app, or Gemini workers with savvy-limits; review.

plugins.name: savvy-progress
plugins.description: Mod: progress bar above the prompt and a live agents panel where every worker, subagent or side session, is a Diablo 2 hero crab.

plugins.name: savvy-limits
plugins.description: Mod: Claude and Gemini 5-hour and weekly limits above the prompt, a capacity tool for the savvy-flow orchestrator, and Gemini workers and image generation through the official agy CLI.

plugins.name: site-crew
plugins.description: Mod: a live panel of every subagent and side session a session starts, nested as they spawn each other, drawn as a construction crew from apprentice to architect. Works with plain Claude Code; lives in its own repository.
